text:
I was sitting in class and my stomach growled loud. The teacher was speaking but I only thought about lunch. Finally the bell screeched and we all ran outside. I opened my lunchbox and saw a weird green thing. It looked like a creature from a scary movie. My mom said it was stewed spinach but it looked gross. I tried to remain calm but I was scared to eat it. My friend Billy looked at it and made a face.

"What is that slimy stuff?" Billy asked me.

"I think it's poisoned alien food," I said back.

I chewed a tiny bite but it tasted like old socks. I used my safety scissors to cut my sandwich instead. I could not contain my happiness when recess was finally over. Next time I will make my own lunch.

My birthday party was almost a complete disaster. My dog Buster chewed up my favorite birthday card from Grandma. I was so mad that I almost threw a pillow at him. Then my brother fought with me about the last slice of pizza.

"It's my birthday so I get the pizza!" I yelled.

"No, I am earning it by cleaning up!" he said back.

We were loud but then my mom walked in with the cake. She put it on the table and I blew out all ten candles. I wished to be invisible so I could sneak more cake later. Tomorrow I will play my new computer game all day long. It ended up being a good day after all.

My best friend Ben came over for a sleepover last night. We wanted to make a big fort in the living room. We pulled all the blankets off my bed carefully.

"This fort is going to be awesome!" I yelled.

We used the couch cushions to make the walls stronger. Then we got inside and started reading comic books with a flashlight. Suddenly, my big brother walked in playing his loud guitar. He was screaming a song and he messed up our cool scenery.

"Get out of here!" Ben shouted at him.

My mom came in with snacks and told my brother to stop. We ate popcorn together inside the fort. There wasn't a single kernel left in the bowl. We were already sleepy but we stayed up super late telling jokes. It was the best night ever.

My nephew Timmy came over for a big sleepover. We were roaming around the backyard looking for bugs. I found a worm and Timmy started groaning loudly.

"That is the slimiest thing on earth!" he yelled.

I grinned and put the worm back in the dirt. We went inside to write a list for our secret club meeting. Then my mom brewed some hot cocoa for us. Timmy ran too fast and crashed into the table. He twisted his ankle a little bit, although he didn't cry. My mom got a needle and thread to fix his ripped pants.

"I hate sitting still," Timmy grumbled while she worked.

I got some scissors to cut paper snowflakes while we waited. We feared the night was ruined but then we built a huge fort. It was the best sleepover ever.

I was walking my dog Max on the trail. It was a nice day and we looked for squirrels. Max started running fast and I had to run too. Suddenly he stopped by a big rock and sniffed it.

"What is that Max?" I asked him.

It was a weird green bug with big eyes. Max put his weight on his front paws and barked. The bug did not move so we walked away. But then I heard a thumping sound behind us. We looked back again and saw a huge rabbit!

"Wow, look at those ears!" I yelled.

The rabbit stared at us a little longer. Then it hopped into the bushes gradually. I was grateful Max didn't chase it. Our walk was complete so we went home for lunch.

It was my birthday party and I invited my best friends. We played games in the backyard and ate pizza. Then we went inside to look at my new painting.

"That looks like a big grey elephant!" said Sam.

I laughed because it was actually a spaceship. We ran through the kitchen and scrambled up the stairs. We wanted to see the trail behind my house from the balcony.

"Look, a dog is approaching!" yelled Mike.

It was just my cat, Fluffy. She scratched at the door and wanted to come in. We counted all the cars on the street. I often get the numbers wrong but Sam helped me. We ate cake and it was the best day ever.

One day my dog Spot and I went exploring outside. We were walking in the woods surrounding my big house. Suddenly we heard a loud thumping noise behind a bush. I thought it was a bear approaching us fast!

"What is that noise, Spot?" I asked my dog.
Spot barked loudly and jumped into the green bushes.

Something flew out and landed right on my shoe. It was just a big frog wearing a leaf! But then Spot scrambled out and he looked funny. His white fur had a big green stain on it. The sun felt hot and scorched my face. The wind blew hard and my hat disappeared. It seemed impossible to find it in the tall grass. We went home and ate toasted cheese sandwiches for lunch.

"That was a crazy adventure," I said to Spot.

It was Wednesday and I was bringing my lunch to school. I had a ham sandwich and an apple. My neighbor Billy sat next to me on the bus. We talked about Minecraft and earning points in the game. When we got to school, I dropped my bag. My apple rolled away!

"Oh no, my apple is gone!" I yelled.

Billy ran after it and caught it by the door. "Here is your fruit," he said.

I was happy. At recess, we played on the swinging bars. I turned upside down and my face got red. Then we had math class. We had to learn about big numbers. It was a good day because I didn't lose my lunch.

It was lunchtime and I was so hungry. I opened my lunchbox and saw a wonderful sandwich. My friend Sam appeared next to me and grinned.

"Is that peanut butter?" Sam asked me loudly.

"Yes, but I can't find my plastic knife," I said.

I realized it fell on the floor under the table. I picked it up but it was dirty enough to wash. Then our teacher Mrs. Green started approaching us. She was always coaching us on good manners.

"Please go wash that quickly," she greeted us warmly.

After lunch, we had science class about building things. We made a big castle out of cardboard boxes. I didn't understand how to make the door open. I felt a little anger but then I started singing a song. Suddenly, the door worked perfectly! It was the best day ever.

My best friend Luke moved away last year. It was sad but he gripped his new house key. He lives in a foreign place called Canada now. Suddenly his mom called my mom. 

"Do you want to come for a sleepover?" she asked.

I shouted, "Yes please!"

We drove for a long time following the map. We finally got there and Luke ran outside. We played a game called King. I had a long reign as the King of the backyard. It gradually got dark outside.

"What happened to the sun?" Luke asked.

"It went to sleep," I said.

We ate pizza and stayed up late. It was the best sleepover ever.

I was so excited for lunch because it was pizza day. I looked at the schedule on the wall and waited. Finally, the bell rang and we all ran to the cafeteria. I got my tray and sat down next to Tommy.

"Look out!" Tommy yelled loudly.

A boy named Kyle threw a paper airplane and it flew fast. It crossed the whole room and crashed into my milk carton. Milk escaped the carton and spread all over my pizza.

"Oh no, that is not the meaning of flying!" I shouted.

The teacher came over and frowned at Kyle. He had to clean it up. My pizza was soggy but I ate it anyway.

My brother Tom and I went into the dark woods. We wanted to find the lost cave. Tom had a map and I had a flashlight. Suddenly, a big bear appeared behind a tree! It looked mad and full of anger.

"Run fast!" I yelled to Tom.

We flew down the path. My backpack got caught on a branch hanging low. I had to squeeze through some bushes. Tom tried to seize my arm to help me. The bear roared loud. It sounded like a giant swearing at us!

"I need some caffeine to run faster!" Tom shouted.

We finally found the cave and hid inside. We were safe but my legs felt like stewed carrots. I found a sharp rock like a needle. We waited until the bear left. It was the scariest day ever.

I woke up really early for my birthday party. My brother was already playing games on the computer. I ran downstairs and saw my mom in the kitchen. She spread pink frosting all over my giant cake.

"Don't touch it yet!" she said very loudly to me.

I went outside and saw my dad fixing the fountain. I started jumping on the trampoline but it felt a little dangerous. Suddenly a bright blue bird flew right past my head. It looked like a shiny jewel in the sky. I ran to follow it down the dirt trail. Then I tripped on a big rock and hurt my knee.

"Ouch that really hurt!" I yelled.

My dad came running but he wasn't swearing or mad. He said it meant we had to go to the hospital. So I spent my birthday getting a bandage instead of eating cake.

My brother and I were playing a new video game. It was about aliens attacking the earth. I was yearning to win because he always beats me. He picked a big monster with twisted horns. I picked a fast robot that shoots lasers.

"You are going to lose!" my younger brother yelled.

I felt anger inside but I stayed quiet. The game started and we both smashed buttons fast. My robot got roasted by his fire breath. I fell down and crawled away to hide. Then I found a secret power-up box. I got a giant shield to wrap around me. I jumped out and blasted him hard.

"No fair!" he shouted while groaning.

I won the fight and became the champion. My reign as the best player finally started today. I will receive the trophy and he is just jealous.

I live in a big apartment building. My new neighbor is a boy named Leo. He is from a foreign country and speaks a different language. Yesterday, I saw him walking to school alone. His shoulders sank down because his backpack was so heavy. I ran up to him.

"Do you want some help with that?" I asked.

Leo smiled big and said, "Yes please, it is full of books."

We walked together. I noticed he didn't comb his hair. That meant he was probably in a rush like me. We play at recess often now. He is my best friend.

My dog Buster is very bad at training. One day he escaped through the open gate. I ran after him but he was too fast. He crawled under Mrs. Green's fence and disappeared. I was waiting for him to come back.

Suddenly I heard a loud bark. Buster ran back bearing a big bone in his mouth! He looked so thrilled.

"Buster, you stole that!" I yelled.

Mrs. Green came out and she looked mad. "Did your dog take my dog's treat?" she asked.

I caught Buster by his collar. "I am sorry," I said. It was not enough though. We had to buy Mrs. Green's dog a new bone. Buster is a very naughty boy.

It was February and my best friend Max came over for a sleepover. We were thrilled because we could stay up super late. My mom greeted us with pizza and snacks. She said, "Don't drink any caffeine or you won't sleep!"

We went to my room and I showed Max my new electric guitar. I am still in training, but my dad is teaching me songs. Max grasped the pick and tried to play, but he simply made a loud noise. We laughed and crawled into our sleeping bags. Then Max’s dog ran in and started dumping his toys on the floor.

"Get out of here, Buster!" Max yelled.

We pushed the dog out and talked about video games until my brain felt tired. It was the best night ever and we were very pleased.

Yesterday at recess we played a fun game. We scrambled up the big hill by the swings. I looked down and saw my friend Tommy climbing fast. He was scared because he thought a monster was chasing us.

"Hurry up before it gets you!" Tommy yelled loudly.

My heart was beating super fast like a drum. We moved to the slide and swam through the air. Then we saw a teacher knitting a red sweater. She had a long needle in her hand. She was singing a funny song about fourteen cats.

"That's not a monster," I said to Tommy.

We laughed and then the bell rang for lunch. I was hungry so I stole a cookie from my box. It was a good day until I lost my newspaper homework. I think my dog ate it again.

I brought my new toy to school today. It was a bright blue jewel. I kept it in my pocket during math class. I thought about playing with it at recess. But then Mrs. Green asked for our homework. I realized I slept too late and forgot it!

"Where is your worksheet, Sam?" she asked me.

"I think my dog ate it," I lied quickly.

Mrs. Green sighed and picked up her big scissors. She cut a piece of paper for me. At recess, I ran to the grassy meadow behind the swings. The wind blew hard like a storm. I saw a white feather floating in the air. I pretended to bungee jump off the slide. Playing is way better than keeping track of homework. I paid for lunch with my crumpled dollar and ate pizza.

My best friend Tom came over for a sleepover on Friday. We wanted to do a cool science experiment in the kitchen. We mixed red juice and baking soda in a big bowl.

"Watch out, it is going to explode!" Tom shouted loudly.

But then the bowl tipped over and red juice went everywhere. I realized it got on my mom's new white rug. It made a huge red stain. I started stamping my feet because I was scared.

"What happened in here?" my mom asked from the doorway.

She looked mad but she didn't complain or yell. We threw lots of paper towels on the mess to clean it. Then we drew a sorry card for her because it was important. My neighbor gave us special cleaner and we fixed it together. We learned that science is messy but mom is nice.

Tim and I walked into the dark, scary cave. We were wearing our new explorer hats and holding flashlights. A weird noise was sounding from deep inside the tunnel.

"I think a monster lives here," Tim whispered loudly.

"Don't be scared," I said, but I gripped my light tighter.

We walked longer and saw a green light ahead. It looked like someone brewed a glowing potion. Suddenly, a big rock bounced down the path! We jumped away just in time. A skeleton hung from the ceiling and it was groaning.

I drew my plastic sword and scratched the skeleton's leg. It was just a science project made of plastic bones! We chose the wrong cave for a real adventure. We ran back outside, bringing the fake leg with us. It was scary but kind of funny too.

I knew today was going to be weird. My teacher Mr. Brown was roaming around the room looking for something important. He kept picking up papers and putting them down. 

"Has anyone seen my silver whistle?" he asked us.

Nobody said anything because we were busy earning points for good behavior. Then the bell rang for recess and we ran outside. It was a beautiful day on earth! We played soccer and Sarah was coaching us on how to kick. Suddenly, a foreign kid named Marco found something shiny in the grass.

"Look, I found the whistle!" Marco yelled loud.

Mr. Brown was so happy he gave us extra recess. It was the best school day ever.

We knew the old house on the hill was scary. My best friend Sam and I walked up the steps. I felt freezing because it was so cold outside. 

"Do you hear that sound?" Sam whispered loudly.

I heard a loud knock on the heavy door. We were both scared but we wanted to explore. I drew a map in my head. We climbed up to the balcony. It was high up like a bungee jump. Suddenly, something scratched the wall behind us!

"Run for your life!" I yelled at Sam.

We ran fast and used our imagination to escape. We pretended we were knights and ended the monster's reign. We were safe at home and ate cookies.

My birthday party was almost ruined by a weird creature. We were in the backyard and my dad was coaching us. We pretended to be in a big soccer league.

Suddenly, a giant bug came floating down from the sky. It looked foreign and scary!

"I am scared of that thing!" yelled my friend Sam.

I grabbed a stick and crossed the grass fast. The bug landed right on my cake. It spread its wings like it wanted to reign over the frosting.

"Get away from the chocolate!" I shouted loud.

My mom scrambled over and shooed it away. She grinned at us.

"Is there enough cake left?" Sam asked.

We cut off the bug part and ate the rest. It was still good. We were not leaving until every crumb was gone.

One day I was roaming in the big green meadow. I saw a shiny knight sitting on a rock. He looked sad because his horse ran away. I went up to him and he looked at me.

"Do you need help?" I asked him quietly.

"Yes, I need to find my magic feather," said the knight.

He told me the feather gave him super strength. We walked for eight miles until we saw a cave. Suddenly a big dragon crashed down from the sky! It was huge and scary. The knight used all his strength to jump high. It was like there was no gravity! He grabbed the feather from the dragon's tail. Then we ran away fast and roasted marshmallows by a fire. We ate lots of protein because we are growing boys.

The mountain looked super big and scary today. My friend Leo and I searched for the secret cave. My heart was thumping hard in my chest.

"Do you think we will find the treasure?" Leo spoke quietly.

"I am certain we will find it!" I shouted back.

We crawled under a big log and looked at the scenery. Suddenly a rock bounced down the hill and almost struck Leo. We jumped out of the way just in time! It felt like a failure, but my dad taught me to never give up.

"Look over there!" Leo pointed at a dark hole.

It was the cave! The map was important after all. We ran inside and found a shiny box. We were the best explorers ever.

I was playing soccer at the park with my friends. We chose teams and I was the goalie. The ball hit my leg hard and it was stinging. I almost started groaning but I stayed strong. Then my friend Sam kicked the ball really high. It looked like it was bungee jumping in the sky.

"Get the ball!" Sam yelled at me loudly.

I ran fast and I turned to catch it. I slept badly last night so I was tired. I missed the ball and it went into the goal.

"Good game," I said, even though we lost.

We were leaving soon so we started roaming around. I learned the meaning of practice that day. Next time I will catch it.

I was exploring outside with my dog Rex. We were roaming in the woods behind my house. It was very quiet but then Rex started barking. He was stamping his paws on the ground. I saw a big black shape in the bushes surrounding us. I got really scared. I thought it was a bear!

"Run away Rex!" I screamed loud.

Rex ran back to me and we ran fast. We were bumping into trees because we were so fast. I fell down and hurt my knee bad. It felt like I needed the hospital. But then I looked back at the bushes. It was just a cow! The cow looked nice enough.

"Moooo," said the cow.

I laughed because I was silly. We went home and I ate roasted marshmallows. It was an important lesson to look closer next time.

I was steering my bike down the big hill. The breeze felt wonderful on my face. My friend Tom was right behind me. We saw a dark cave and we stopped.

"Do you have the flashlight?" Tom asked.

"Yes, but I am scared," I said.

We opened the scary door to the cave. It was very dark inside. Suddenly we heard a loud growl. We realized a bear lived there! We ran out super fast. Later, we were loading wood for a fire. We roasted marshmallows and told stories. It was an incredible day, but I lost my scissors in the woods.

I was yearning for recess all morning long. My teacher Mrs. Miller made us do lots of reading. It was super boring and I simply wanted to go outside. Finally the bell rang and everyone pushed to the door.

We ran to the big swings. But Tommy got there early and took the best one. I pulled on the chain but he was too heavy.

"Hey, I counted to ten already!" I yelled at him.

"You need more strength to move me!" Tommy laughed.

I felt crushed because I really wanted to swing. Then I thought about our class camping trip next week. That made me happy again. I sat down and found a loose thread on my shirt. Recess was okay even without the swings.

It was finally my birthday and I was so excited. My heart was thumping hard like a drum in my chest. My friends neared the table with a huge mountain of presents.

"Open the big blue one first!" shouted my friend Tim.

I grinned and ripped the paper off very fast. It was the greatest robot toy ever and its eyes lit up. Then Mom came in dumping a bag of candy on the table. My excitement grew and I could not contain my happiness.

"Did you do your chores for earning this?" Dad asked.

"Yes I did!" I said and counted all my candy.

Neither Tim nor I wanted the plain chocolate bars. We ate the sour gummies until a blue vein popped out. It was the best day ever.

Yesterday me and my friend Sam went on a big adventure. We pretended my backyard was a scary jungle. 

"Look out for the tigers!" shouted Sam. 

I saw a big tree and started climbing it fast. It was like climbing a giant mountain. Branches were twisted everywhere throughout the leaves. 

"It is impossible to get me up here," I said. 

Sam tried to jump but he fell in the grass. We needed more company to fight the monsters. So we ran inside to get my dog. We spread a blanket on the floor and pretended it was a boat. Then we played on my computer until dinner. It was the best day ever.

I was eating my lunch outside because the weather was nice. I had a sandwich with peanut butter spread all over it. Suddenly, Tommy came jumping over the bench. He accidentally hit my arm and my juice box went flying! It looked like zero gravity in space.

"Oh no, I am so sorry!" Tommy yelled.

The juice landed on Mrs. Lee's shoes. She looked mad. I gripped my sandwich tight because I was scared. It felt like I was getting roasted by the sun.

"You two need to be more careful," Mrs. Lee said.

We cleaned it up fast. It was like dumping water out of a boating trip. I hope tomorrow is better than today. It will be heaven if I can just eat my lunch.

My friends and I went on a big adventure in the woods. We were looking for a secret cave that my brother discovered last week. The wind blew hard and the sky looked like a storm brewed. We felt scared but we kept walking. Suddenly I saw a dark hole in a giant rock.

"Look at that!" I shouted to Sam and growing excitement filled me.

We jumped over a log and ran to the cave. It was super dark inside and everything looked spooky. Then we heard a loud roar. A bear was inside and it sounded hungry!

"Run away fast!" Sam yelled and grasped my arm tight.

I dropped my flashlight and we ran back home. We were safe in my yard and everyone was cheering. We didn't find treasure but it was still cool. Next time we might bring bungee cords to escape faster!

Me and my neighbor Sam went to the old scary house. We looked inside the dark window and saw a shadow. A cold breeze hit my face and I shivered. We pushed the big door open and it made a noise.

"Do you think a monster lives here?" asked Sam quietly.

"I hope we don't find any ghosts," I said back.

We walked in and I saw a huge black beetle. It was crawling on a dusty table near a book. I read the book but it was speaking strange words! Suddenly a bat flew out and Sam screamed really loud. He almost fainted on the floor but I grabbed him. We ran outside fast to receive some sunlight. We never went back there again because it was too spooky.

My friends and I went into the dark woods. We wanted to find the lost cave. Max led the way because he is brave. Suddenly we heard a scary sound. Something screeched loudly in the trees! 

"Run fast!" yelled Max.

We ran and I tripped on a twisted root. I thought I was stuck but I got up. We reached the cave and went inside. It was very dark but we had lights. We saw a giant beetle on the wall. It was huge and scary but not dangerous. 

"We did it!" I said, cheering loudly.

We learned that we are brave enough today. We escaped the woods and went home. We were earning a big snack after that. We were happy meaning to go back soon.

One day I was walking up a big mountain. It was raining really hard and I was cold. Suddenly I saw a huge metal castle at the top. A giant robot was standing there clinging to the wall. He had big scissors for hands and looked scary.

"Hey you!" I shouted at the robot.

The robot looked down and screeched a loud noise. He was dumping rocks down the side of the hill. I held up my magic thumb and it started glowing.

"Stop that right now!" I said. "This is important!"

The robot stopped making that ringing sound. He was actually friendly and just wanted to play. We played games all day sounding happy together.

It was finally my birthday and I was so thrilled! My mom drove us to the trampoline park for my party. My best friend Sam sat next to me and grinned.

"Are you ready to jump really high?" Sam asked me.

"Yes, I trained all week for this," I said back.

We ran inside and put on our special sticky socks. I saw the big bungee jump ride in the corner. I gripped the ropes tightly and I felt brave enough. I jumped super high and felt like I escaped gravity! But then I landed funny and felt a stinging pain.

"Are you okay?" my mom asked when I came down.

I nodded and said, "It's just science, what goes up must come down!"

Everyone laughed and understood that I was fine. Then we ate pizza until nobody spoke because our mouths were full.

I was in the big kickball league at recess today. My team was losing, but then I held the red ball. I kicked it so hard and it flew over the fence!

"That was incredible!" screamed my friend Leo.

I ran around all the bases and felt very pleased. Later, we went inside for art class and used sharp scissors. We cut out pictures from an old newspaper for a collage. The teacher brewed some tea, and the room smelled like roasted nuts.

"Please start loading your backpacks," said Mrs. Green.

She sent us home with no homework. I stood on my balcony at home and felt happy. It was the best day ever.

One cold day in February, I went exploring in the woods. I heard a loud noise behind a big bush. Suddenly, a huge black dog appeared and I screamed really loud. I thought I was in big danger.

"Stay back!" I shouted at the dog.

The dog just wagged his tail and started groaning. I realized he was stuck on a branch. I was grateful he was nice. My dad came running over because he heard me.

"Is that a wolf?" my dad asked.

"No, it's just a stuck puppy," I said.

My dad grumbled because he was loading the car. He helped the dog get loose. The dog licked my face. I guarantee he is the best dog ever. We took him home and we are leading him to his new bed now. My mom was swearing a little bit because he had muddy paws.

It was raining outside so recess was inside today. I was mad because I wanted to play soccer. My teacher Mrs. Miller said we had to write a story. She said it was very important for our grades. I tried to write about a colonel in the army. He was camping in the woods and it was freezing. Then he heard a noise and got really scared. He grabbed his pocket knife but it was just a bunny.

"This is impossible!" I screamed at my paper.

Mrs. Miller came over and looked at my work. She smiled and gave me a gold star receipt. Everyone started cheering for me and I felt happy.

It was my birthday party and everyone was screaming with joy. We were in the backyard pumping up huge water balloons. My dad was coaching my team and he is a champion balloon thrower. Unfortunately, the other team had my big brother who I feared.

I saw him roaming around the bushes and then he disappeared. Suddenly I felt something wet and cold.

"Gotcha!" he yelled sounding very loud.

He touched my shoulder with a popped balloon. It was not pleasant especially because I was wearing my new shirt. Then I saw a tiny feather floating down. It landed on my nose.

"You missed me!" I shouted back at him.

We kept playing until it got dark and we ate cake. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my dog Max went exploring in the woods. We walked on a dirt path and looked at trees. Max was sniffing everything and bumping into my legs.

"Look, Max! A big squirrel!" I yelled loudly.

Max tried to seize the squirrel, but it was too fast. It ran up a tree and disappeared. Then we saw a weird blue stain on a rock.

"What is that?" I asked Max.

He just barked. Suddenly a deer appeared in the surrounding bushes. It looked at us for a long time. I thought it was hungry and needed protein. We went home together because it was getting dark. My mom was on the balcony waiting for us. She likes our company. Max was tired but happy.

I was playing soccer with my friend Max in the park. The grass was wet and I slipped and twisted my ankle. It hurt so much like a stinging bee sting.

"Are you okay?" Max shouted and ran over to me.

I held my leg and screamed a little bit because it hurt. My mom saw me fall and she moved very fast to help.

"That is enough playing for today," she said nicely.

She brought me inside because it was getting cold outside. She said I could catch pneumonia if I stayed in the cold air. Max came inside too to guide me to the couch. The reason we stopped was because of my ankle, but then we played video games. In the game there was a lot of danger and monsters. Max was teaching me how to win the level. It was still a fun day.

Yesterday was a weird day at school. I was trembling because I forgot my big homework project. I felt stinging tears in my eyes. Then Mrs. Baker met me at the door. She looked very nice and she smiled.

"Why are you so sad today, Tommy?" she asked.

"I didn't do my training log for gym class," I said.

She laughed and said it was okay. I was so thrilled! At recess, we played tag and I ran fast. I tried to seize the flag from Billy. He fell down and hurt his knee especially bad. He cried and said he needed a hospital. The teacher sang a funny song to make him feel better. I am certain he was bringing drama just for attention. It was a crazy day.

One day I went exploring in the big meadow behind my house. It was a pleasant day for climbing trees. My dog Spot followed me everywhere. I decided to sit down and write a story in my notebook. Suddenly, a tiny brown rabbit appeared near a bush.

"Look at that bunny, Spot!" I whispered loudly.

Spot let out a little whistle noise because he was excited. He started to run, but I held his collar.

"Don't chase him or he will complain to his mom!" I joked.

We stayed very still, waiting for the rabbit to move. It hopped away fast. Exploring outside is the best fun ever.

We were playing soccer at recess and I was afraid. The other team was winning and they were really fast. My friend Tim stole the ball and ran down the field. He kicked it hard but the goalie stopped it.

"Pass it to me next time!" I yelled to Tim.

We started running again and the ball came to me. I remembered my dad speaking to me about keeping my head up. I dribbled past a big kid and saw the goal. It felt like I was dreaming because I was so open. I kicked it right into the corner!

"Nice shot!" Tim said and gave me a high five.

We won the game and I felt happy not like a scared little lamb. We can't wait to play again tomorrow.

I went exploring in the woods behind my house today. The scenery was full of big green trees and bushes. I was looking for my lost dog named Buster. I was keeping my eyes open for his red collar.

I reached the old creek and heard a weird noise. It sounded like something was groaning in the mud. I was certain it was a monster or something foreign.

"Is anyone there?" I screamed very loudly.

Then I saw a tail wagging near a log. It was Buster and he was struggling to walk. He was wearing a vine on his leg like a trap. I helped him get free and he licked my face.

"You silly dog!" I said while hugging him tight.

We sprinted all the way back home together. I told him to remain in the yard forever. Our search and meeting was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster and I went on a big adventure. We walked down the trail behind my house. I gripped the leash tight because Buster pulls hard. Suddenly we saw a squirrel jump like a bungee cord!

"Look at that, Buster!" I yelled loudly.

Buster barked immediately and tried to chase it. We ran fast and my feet made a loud rhythm. We stopped at the big oak tree. It was fourteen steps away from the creek. A mother duck and her daughter were swimming there. We sat and watched them for a long time.

"I am grateful we came outside," I whispered to Buster.

We were waiting for dinner time. Mom said she stewed some carrots for us later. We walked home happy and tired.

My big brother Max turned thirteen today. We had a party in the backyard. Dad was steering the grill, but the fire grew way too big! He started screaming because he burned the hot dogs. Mom said, "Oh no, that is a total failure."

Then our dog Buster ate the burnt hot dogs. I was waiting for cake, but Max was swearing quietly because he dropped his present. It was a cool leather wallet. We had to search in the grass for his money.

Later, Grandpa read the newspaper and ignored us. I asked him, "What is the meaning of thirteen?"

He laughed and said, "It means trouble!" It was a crazy birthday, but we still had ice cream.
